newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa rand ends year at 4.68 on dlr, bonds flat.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa rand ends year at 4.68 on dlr, bonds flat.

text.p: 1000 GMT - Rand ends the year at 4.6800/6850 against the dollar after an exceptionally quiet trading session. Bonds little changed in trade described by dealers as a non-event.

* Rand ticks up from earlier 4.6760/6810 on small amounts of importer dollar demand but volumes exceptionally thin, dealers say. Activity expected to pick up again next week. All markets closed on Wednesday for New Year's Day holiday.

* Key R150 last at 16.095 pct from previous 16.09 pct close. Dealers say trade a non-event with only a handful of deals going through. Market looking to money supply and credit data on Thursday for direction.
